note: Lolo NF (Missoula RD) above Rock Creek, a blue-ribbon trout stream, in mixed conifer: Rock Creek exit #126 off I-90 (20 mi east of Missoula), then 14.5 mi south on Rock Creek Rd #102. 8 of the 10 sites take a tent or RV; max trailer 32 ft. Forest Service: 'Trailers, motorhomes and tow vehicles not recommended due to the narrow and rough road' and 'Large RVs not recommended.' --Claude
summary: Forest Service page confirms FCFS, hand-pump potable water, $15/night peak (no fee non-peak); added flush toilets and the 2026 season May 1 - Sept 28 (closed for the season now). Not stated: site count (derived 10 left), trailer length, stay limit. Note trimmed of the restated water/toilet, FCFS and fee text; its softer road caveat replaced by the Forest Service's own wording.
